newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain will not cut VAT on housing - Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain will not cut VAT on housing - Rato.

text.p: The Spanish government will not reduce the current level of value-added-tax on housing in either the private or the public sector, Economy Ministry Rodrigo Rato said on Friday.
After today's cabinet meeting Rato told reporters a cut "hasn't been suggested, nor does the government plan to modify the rate."
Recently local media reported the possibility that the government intended to reduce VAT on housing.
Currently the rate on housing is seven percent.
